title: RESPONSIBLE INTELLIGENCE IN PRACTICE: A FAIRNESS AUDIT OF OPEN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS FOR LIBRARY REFERENCE SERVICES

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in synthetic library reference queries to signal user sex (male/female), followed by diagnostic classification (using Logistic Regression, MLP, and XGBoost) of the LLMs' TF-IDF response features to test if the user's sex can be predicted above chance, and statistical lexical analysis to identify distinguishing words.

Counterfactual name substitution in synthetic library reference queries using US Census-derived surnames to signal user race/ethnicity (across six groups), followed by diagnostic classification of the LLM responses to evaluate if demographic membership can be predicted, alongside interpretative analysis of linguistic markers.
